coverageNotes: Web-search budget (shared across the 33 researchers) ran out after the first 16 fintech lookups, so everything after that was verified by fetching company contact/about/legal pages directly plus the offline OSM extract; Nominatim/Photon were also throttled (429) for the last third, so several building-level addresses carry street- or locality-level points and are marked medium/low accordingly. CONFIRMED FROM OFFICIAL PAGES: smallcase, Scripbox, Perfios, KredX, M2P (3 offices), Jar, Stable Money, Fam, Signzy, Sarvam AI, Krutrim, Yellow.ai, MoEngage, Amagi, LeadSquared, Exotel, Whatfix, SpotDraft (2), Uniphore, Mindtickle, Pixxel (2), Bellatrix, Digantara, Niramai, SigTuple, Tricog (2), Ati Robotics, Tonbo (4), Stellapps (map pin only), String Bio, Bugworks, Eyestem; Cashfree's old office from its press kit and its new Ecoworld HQ from lease news. REGISTRY/AGGREGATOR ONLY (medium): Niyo, Fi, Rupeek, Khatabook, Open (MCA-derived listing), Simpl (LEI). OSM-POI ONLY (low): Instamojo, Zeta, Capillary, Kaleyra, GalaxEye (medium, website-tagged POI), Kuvera (CB Insights, low). Pandorum is low because its site answered 503 every time. UNICORNS KEPT DESPITE THE 'non-unicorn' brief because they were on the lens list, each flagged isUnicorn=true: Open, Zeta, M2P, Perfios, Krutrim, Amagi, LeadSquared, Mindtickle. LEFT OUT - no Bengaluru address could be substantiated (sites carry no postal address or were 403/404/503/rate-limited): Setu (entities Anumati Technologies / BrokenTusk Technologies found, no address), Hyperface, Decentro, Locus (Mara Labs), Hasura/PromptQL, Hevo Data, Skyflow (site lists Palo Alto only), Appsmith (remote-first), Toplyne (wound down in 2024), Observe.AI (site lists Redwood City only), Vymo, Entropik (site names Bangalore but no address), Gnani.ai, Slang Labs, Log9 Materials, CynLr, Fasal (Wolkus Technology Solutions, no address), plus extra candidates Juspay, Navi, KreditBee, Hiver, Fyle and Moneyview that were tried and gave no address. NOT BENGALURU, verified or by HQ: Lentra (Pune only on its contact page), Zenoti (Hyderabad only), CleverTap (Mumbai; footer names Bengaluru but no office address), Vivriti (Chennai), Lendingkart (Ahmedabad, excluded as instructed), OneCard/FPL (Pune), Dezerv (Mumbai), Kissflow, Rocketlane, Mad Street Den and Agnikul (Chennai), Druva (Pune, page unreachable), WebEngage (Mumbai, 403), Ozonetel (Hyderabad, no address), Atlan (Delhi/remote), Skyroot (Hyderabad), Qure.ai (Mumbai) - the last nine were not fetched because of budget and rest on their known HQs. Groww and Postman (E07), Ultraviolette (E09) were left to those lenses; Niramai overlaps E09 and is included here from its official page. KredX's earlier Salarpuria Softzone office and Stellapps' earlier Domlur office (OSM) are omitted rather than marked closed, since neither closure is documented. Headcounts were not stated by any source consulted, so bengaluruEmployeesApprox is null throughout.
